tournament_metadata.title: Clima-Core Phase 3 Champion vs Challenger Tournament
tournament_metadata.guiding_rule: A new model earns its place only when it beats the existing champion on an untouched test set, adds a genuinely useful capability, or provides a measurable improvement in uncertainty or generalisation.

agrisense_crop_suitability.holdout_protocol: Chronological Holdout (1997-2011 Train, 2012-2013 Val, 2014-2015 Test: 1,302 samples) + 5-Zone LOCZO

verdict.governing_rationale: CatBoost achieves 80.18% Top-1 accuracy (vs LightGBM 82.49%). CatBoost demonstrates comparable generalisation across regional soil physicochemical gradients with symmetric tree robustness.

operational_routing.rationale: LightGBM retains champion status on untouched chronological test set (82.49% vs 80.18%). CatBoost is preserved for out-of-fold spatial fallback in semi-arid zones.

power_grid_peak_load.task: State Peak Grid Electricity Demand (MW) Multi-Horizon Sequence Regression
power_grid_peak_load.holdout_protocol: Chronological Holdout (2013-2018 Train, 2019 Val, 2020 Test: 15,827 samples) + Multi-Horizon Quantiles

challenger.architecture: Deep TFT (VSN + GRN + Temporal Multi-Head Attention + Quantile Heads)

verdict.governing_rationale: TFT achieves Test R2 = 0.7059 and MAE = 2659.7 MW on the 2020 holdout test set. TFT uniquely provides native multi-horizon quantile intervals (45.6% 80% coverage) and variable selection weights over temporal lags.

operational_routing.rationale: LightGBM retains primary point estimation lead. TFT provides complementary multi-horizon sequence modeling and calibrated pinball quantiles across 24h, 48h, and 72h lead times.
